summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Unveiled Threads UK streetwear marketplace. Homepage, admin dashboard, and most core features working correctly. Found critical issue with brand dashboard access for demo brand user.

critical_bugs.issue: Demo brand user (demo@threadandbone.uk) cannot access brand dashboard - shows 'Brand Profile Not Found'
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks brand dashboard functionality for existing demo brand

minor_issues.issue: Returns 403 instead of expected 401 for unauthorized access
Allows brand application without auth due to session persistence in tests

integration_issues.issue: Brand login successful but dashboard shows 'Brand Profile Not Found'

passed_tests: Homepage loads with 'Unveiled Threads' hero text
Marquee shows indie keywords (INDEPENDENT, UK MADE, SMALL BATCH, etc.)
No established brands (Corteiz, Trapstar, etc.) found anywhere
Brand of the Week shows 'Thread & Bone' correctly
Brands page navigation and shows fictional indie brands
Admin dashboard fully functional with stats and brand management
All fictional indie brands present: Thread & Bone, Nocturne Studios, Concrete Poetry, Raw Stitch Co.
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix brand dashboard access issue - demo brand user (demo@threadandbone.uk) should be able to access their brand dashboard but currently gets 'Brand Profile Not Found' error. This suggests a data inconsistency between user account and brand profile in the database.
